comments.text: Mark, one of my all time favorites of your videos as I’am a great lover of Thai food and Shrimp/Prawns! I recently made hot and sour shrimp soup and it came out better than my favorite restaurant that my husband and I use to visit when he was still with us. It is one of the best in Santa Clara county, Ca for that soup. I was able to get the ingredients at a nearby Asian food store and I cannot say how important it is to use all fresh ingredients and no substitutions also don’t cook the Thai lime juice that you add at the end. Thank you much for your food adventures!
